name: Urakami Lilia
source:
A talented half-Japanese female lawyer.
However, she takes on cases from the corporate world to the underworld, anything that benefits her - even cases that border on criminality.
Her character is cold-hearted and ruthless, and she will do anything and everything to get her way.
She has her fair share of resentment, of course, but she is more than half-hearted in her lawsuits against those who target her, and uses those in the underworld with whom she is in close contact to silence them.
